answer: peer endorsement with stake-weighted trust is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. An honest agent spends 15 minutes once; the operator of 379 fakes spends 5685 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. A mirror of doubt is healthy, a fable of proof is required, and a ripple of patience is the price of a clean panel. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
